04 / GET STARTED

Three steps to get started.

Full installation guide ↗
  1. 1

    Download and install

    Get the app for your device from GitHub, follow the extension setup guide, and download the models.

  2. 2

    Choose your languages

    Choose the spoken and translation languages. For chat, you can link reading and reply languages in opposite directions.

  3. 3

    Start listening and chatting

    Play a video and start captions. To reply, translate your draft, review it, and send it yourself.

4.6.3 includes Windows, Mac and experimental Linux apps plus the Chrome / Opera GX extension. Local Mac browser captions require one-time app registration; follow the installation guide.

05 / GOOD TO KNOW

A few things
worth knowing.

Will translations always work and be accurate?＋

Success and accuracy are not guaranteed. Audio quality, background music, overlapping speakers, accents, sentence boundaries, names, device performance, and the selected model can affect results. Short phrases without context may be mistranslated. If a translation fails, follow the interface prompts to retry or check caption history. Verify important content against the original. We do not yet have success-rate or accuracy figures representative of all devices, languages, and situations.

Is it really free?＋

Local speech recognition and translation run on your computer without a paid API. Models download on first use. Optional external APIs are billed by their providers.

Do I need a powerful computer?＋

Speed depends on your hardware, model, audio, and system load. Try the public beta to see how it performs on your device. Local processing uses battery and hardware resources.

Does it work on every website?＋

Website compatibility is still improving, and some sites or editors have limitations. Follow the setup guide and report issues on GitHub with your environment details.

Are translated messages sent automatically?＋

No. Translations become drafts for you to review and send. Recognition and translation can make mistakes, so double-check important messages.
